name: Review and report
description: Accept / reject / uncertain review of candidates (galaxy rows: catalog columns REVIEW, REVIEW_NOTE, REVIEW_TIME; moving / transient / detection rows: the same columns in the view, kept with the view and savable to a TSV; filterable, recorded as informational session steps) and a self-contained HTML (optionally PDF) report with cut-outs, measurements and processing provenance.

params.name: include
params.label: Candidates
params.help: table = the rows the table shows now (text search and review filter); the others select by review state from the whole catalog.

params.name: sort_by
params.label: Sort by column
params.help: Catalog column name; a leading - sorts descending (e.g. -MAG_AUTO). Empty keeps the catalog order.

params.name: max_rows
params.label: Maximum candidates listed
params.help: Further candidates are counted but not listed (each cut-out is embedded in the HTML, about 3 kB).

params.name: thumbnails
params.label: Cut-outs (PNG)
params.help: Embed a PNG cut-out of the image around each candidate.

params.name: cutout_size
params.label: Cut-out size
params.help: Side of the square cut-out in image pixels.

params.name: thumb_zoom
params.label: Zoom
params.help: Integer enlargement of the cut-out in the report.

params.name: stretch
params.label: Stretch
params.help: One stretch from the whole image is used for all cut-outs.

params.name: marker
params.label: Mark candidate position
params.help: Draw a yellow circle at the centre of each cut-out.

params.name: all_columns
params.label: List all measurements
params.help: Add a collapsible line with every catalog column under each candidate.

params.name: columns
params.label: Columns shown
params.help: Comma-separated column names for the main table; empty = standard selection plus analysis columns.

params.name: pdf
params.label: Also write a PDF
params.help: Needs Chrome/Chromium (headless) on PATH; otherwise only the HTML is written and a warning is logged.
